items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died
items.claim: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of Aaron's two sons

items.quote: when they offered before the LORD, and died
items.claim: Aaron's two sons offered before the LORD and died

items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to tell Aaron not to enter the holy place at all times

items.quote: Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark
items.claim: Aaron should not enter the holy place before the mercy seat
items.place: into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat

items.quote: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat
items.claim: The LORD will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat
items.place: in the cloud upon the mercy seat
